notes: POC scope: validate throughput guarantees (tokens/sec per GPU), 99th pct latency SLO with 95% confidence intervals, and scale behavior under 3x traffic bursts.
Primary constraint: live product cannot tolerate >100ms 99th latency for chat flows; ops team wants predictable tail behavior even during batch reranking spikes.
Autoscaling preferences: prefer proactive warm pools (pre-warmed KV caches) + vertical scale for heavy model variants; aggressive horizontal scale only for stateless embedding jobs.
Scale-up policy proposed: warm-pool hold at 15-25% of baseline traffic; scale-up threshold at 75% sustained queue depth for 30s; use region-level routing fallback to secondary pool.
Scale-down policy proposed: staggered cool-down - shrink warm pool only after 10m of sub-threshold utilization; tie cache eviction window to downscale operation to avoid repeated cold starts.
Queueing behavior: prefer bounded request queue with backpressure (HTTP 429) over unlimited buffering; customer wants visibility hooks into queue length for alerts.
SLA negotiation points: strict language around 'reserved throughput' vs 'best-effort burst'; customer wants 'guaranteed token/sec per reserved GPU' clause or explicit credit refund.
Model preferences: Llama-2-70B int8 / mix of curated open models; interested in quantized variants to reduce GPU memory pressure for warm pools.
Cost sensitivity: mid-high; willing to commit to 12 month reserved capacity if tail SLOs and autoscaling behavior proven in POC.
Quote from Head of Platform: "We need predictable tail latency — it's the difference between keeping an SLA with our logistics partners and losing a lane."
summary: Enterprise evaluation for Dedicated capacity to support low-tail-latency chat and high-throughput embeddings.
